info.title: offline-pi
info.description: The API of offline-pi: one domain per feature, under /api/<domain>/.

path.description: web route of the module (e.g. /maps/); also its passthrough under /svc

enabled.description: switched on (persisted); modules not installed are never enabled

missing.description: requires[] entries that are still unset

state.description: 'missing' = no container, otherwise the container's state (running, exited, created, ...)

error.description: last start/stop failure, cleared on the next attempt

control.description: core can reach podman.socket and start/stop modules

pinRequired.description: start/stop needs the X-Control-Pin header (CONTROL_PIN is set)

inputVolts.description: Pi 5 PMIC EXT5V_V: the 5 V rail as delivered by the PSU

socWatts.description: Sum of the PMIC rails (Pi 5 only); excludes USB peripherals

psuMaxCurrentMa.description: Current the PSU negotiated via USB-PD (Pi 5 only)

usbHighCurrent.description: true = USB ports may draw 1.6 A, false = limited to 600 mA

underVoltageNow.description: live under-voltage alarm from the rpi_volt hwmon

app.description: compose project, i.e. the offline-pi app directory

cpuPercent.description: share of the whole machine, percent

self.description: the container core runs in (cannot be stopped from here)

counts.description: TCP sockets per state (ESTABLISHED, LISTEN, TIME_WAIT, ...)

minutes.description: one point per minute, last 24 h

ready.description: true once tiles can be downloaded and rendered

diskWarning.description: set when the archive would not comfortably fit on the disk

stage.description: short label for the current step, e.g. "downloading tiles"

detail.description: context when disambiguating, e.g. "Germany" or the OSM type

name.description: override the region id used in URLs and filenames

build.description: planet build to extract from, YYYYMMDD; omit for the latest

force.description: replace an existing region of the same name

emoji.description: a single emoji, rendered as the map marker

status.description: sent messages: pending | sent | acked | failed; received: null

pmtilesUrl.description: archive for the pmtiles:// protocol, under core's passthrough

spriteBase.description: sprite base without theme, e.g. /svc/mesh-map/sprites/ (append "light" or "dark")

meshRunning.description: the mesh module runs; nodes is empty otherwise

ownNum.description: our own node number (marks "you"), when the radio is connected

name.description: kiwix book name, part of its content URLs

language.description: ISO 639-3 code(s) of the first language, e.g. "eng"

size.description: bytes of the ZIM file, when known

fulltext.description: has a full-text index (searchable), otherwise titles only

viewerUrl.description: kiwix's viewer with its toolbar, e.g. /svc/library/viewer#wikipedia_en_all

state.description: running = downloading or checking now; unknown = no status yet (never synced, or not readable)

phase.description: while running: checking what's missing, fetching the Kiwix catalog, downloading a book

downloadedBytes.description: bytes on disk so far (approximate: from the partial file), null when unknown

index.description: position of the current book in the selection (1-based), 0 when none

failed.description: books that failed in this run

result.description: last finished run: ok, problems or interrupted

update.description: also download newer versions of installed books (old files stay until pruned)

key.description: Kiwix name: the ZIM file name without date suffix and ".zim"

size.description: bytes: the installed file's size, else the approximate download size; null when unknown

freeBytes.description: bytes free in KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT_DIR, null when unknown

viewerUrl.description: kiwix viewer URL for the article

book.description: title of the book it is in

kind.description: core = core's own Nest logger (in memory); container = podman logs

containerError.description: why container logs can't be read (no podman socket), else null

ts.description: ms since epoch; null when the line carries no time

level.description: parsed from the line (Nest, JSON, Python logging); "log" when unknown

context.description: Nest context or logger name, e.g. "ModulesService"

stream.description: the container stream it came from (null for core's own buffer)

available.description: false when the logs can't be read; see error

slug.description:
URL path of the page: the file path without numeric prefixes, ".md" and
"README" ("02-installation/01-install.md" -> "installation/install",
"README.md" -> "")

title.description: the first "# " heading, else the file name

depth.description: 0 = docs/README.md, 1 = a chapter, 2 = a page of a chapter, ...

root.description: where the files are, for "read them without the app" hints

prev.description: the pages before and after in reading order

trail.description: the chapters above this page, outermost first (no docs/README.md)

snippet.description: the first line that matches, as plain text

minutes.description: one point per minute, last 24 h

live.description: every sample of the last 15 minutes
